curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: value the role of accurate pronunciation in oral fluency.

mission.title: Clear Words and a Confident Voice

interactions.prompt: A friend asks for a pen. Which clear word helps you understand?
interactions.feedback: Yes! Saying pen clearly gives the right meaning.
interactions.retryHint: Listen for the middle sound in pen.

interactions.prompt: Which speaking habit makes words easy to understand?
interactions.feedback: Correct! Clear sounds support fluent speech.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the habit that helps a listener hear each word.

interactions.prompt: Mali wants the cup, not the cap. Which word should she pronounce carefully?
interactions.feedback: Great listening! Accurate pronunciation tells the listener she wants the cup.
interactions.retryHint: Look at the object Mali wants.

interactions.prompt: Choose the clear sentence to say during class news.
interactions.feedback: Well done! Clear words at a smooth pace sound fluent.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the sentence with clear spaces and a natural pace.

interactions.prompt: Why should you pronounce mat and map accurately?
interactions.feedback: Exactly! Clear pronunciation protects the meaning.
interactions.retryHint: Picture a mat and a map. Are they the same object?

interactions.prompt: Your partner speaks clearly during a story. What is the best response?
choices: Listen and appreciate the clear speech
interactions.answer: Listen and appreciate the clear speech
interactions.feedback: Excellent! You value accurate pronunciation and oral fluency.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the kind response that supports clear speaking.
